# Exploring Bibliometrics

An example of this can be found in our paper for AVI 2026: [Can sonification aid the perception of complex visual networked data? A tool for the interactive exploration of bibliometric data](https://dl.acm.org/doi/10.1145/3811427.3811439)

Workflow: load a graph from Zotero or other source.
- Filter it
- Study it
- Remove, cluster, etc..
- Export as video,image, audio
